plain: Eventually Your Kindle will crack if you open and close your kindle many times a day or simply lend it to someone else who doesn't know better. The hinge that attaches to the kindle will eventually put pressure on the front plastic cover and soon you will see it crack. This one isn't as sturdy as the origami case and slides so that my kindle falls down a lot:( Not an Impressive Case. It doesn't line up properly when closed, so the Fire seems to come out of sleep mode.
